reserveReview.rationale: Bureau Veritas (Inspectorate International) April 2026 cycle (artefact read this pass): silver 3,688,827.985 ozt fine equivalent as at ledger date 20 April 2026 vs 3,683,448.057 KAG per the issuer cover letter (excess matches the five ~1000ozt reserve bars). The BV report reconciles physical holdings to vault records only; the token comparison is the issuer's own cover-letter assertion. Rechecked the exact ERC-20 terms on 2026-10-02: section 8(a) identifies native KAG, not allocated bullion, as the immediate reserve; section 8(e) denies holder title to that reserve and section 3 denies obligations of the native issuer to ERC-20 holders. The immediate reserve is therefore an external native-token claim, classified consistently with KAU rather than as directly allocated silver. This adverse identity correction does not refresh the historical composition or verify current wrapper reserve quantities.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: KMS Labs terms describe the Ethereum token's immediate reserve as native KAG held in segregated issuer-maintained wallets. The issuer homepage identifies GAJ6XIVDKRHVMYF5ZUDDJCX755F25JXGIAWX4JO2OUHC4B2XHVTA6ERC as the KMS Labs native KAG reserve wallet; a live native-chain account read on 2026-10-02 returned 35,000.0990400 KAG. This balance is an observation, not an independently reconciled current reserve envelope or a refreshed composition. Physical silver remains downstream backing; the issuer says independent ERC-20 reserve verification will be disclosed separately.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The Ethereum token's immediate reserve is native KAG held by KMS Labs in segregated wallets. Section 8(e) denies ERC-20 holders legal, equitable or beneficial title to these reserves and disclaims any trust or fiduciary relationship; bankruptcy remoteness and a rehypothecation prohibition are not established. ABX, Brinks and Loomis are downstream physical-bullion custody providers for native KAG; provider shares remain undisclosed. The issuer homepage identifies native reserve wallet GAJ6XIVDKRHVMYF5ZUDDJCX755F25JXGIAWX4JO2OUHC4B2XHVTA6ERC. Wallet identity does not establish a complete reserve census, independent wrapper-liability reconciliation or enforceable holder safeguards.
